goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann politische Reaktionen auf sozialen Wandel erläutern.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: A civic roundtable links changed needs to explicitly possible political measures: childcare, training and accessible housing. Equal participation and the word Mögliche prevent the arrow from becoming a guarantee of successful policy effects. Friendly participants and shared deliberation do not assert a current party programme.
actualInspection.phone: At360px the title, roundtable, large direction arrow and three policy-family icons are clear. Small speech bubbles are supplementary examples, not required to identify policy responses.
actualInspection.desktop: At680px the distinction between needs and possible measures and the examples can be read without dense legal detail.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: The displayed tabletop symbols and labels are explanatory overlays; people face their discussion partners. Blank/generic notes do not contain actor-inverted compulsory text.
actualInspection.style: Friendly clear comic raster, coherent broad colors and approachable people, without photorealism or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: Speech bubbles depict individual example concerns and aspirations, not universal needs of all ages or guaranteed policy outcomes.
goalTextStatus: Actual current canonical German title/description inspected and matched to bilingual E1 author candidate; no D/P gate attested by this image review.
